Which statement about diamond and graphite is correct?
A
Diamond and graphite contain strong covalent bonds between carbon atoms.
B
Diamond and graphite have delocalised electrons.
C
Diamond and graphite have layered structures.
D
Diamond and graphite have low melting points.
